emplacement: Thèmes & destinations · bandeau d'ouverture sous le titre
alt: Panorama en papier déchiré mêlant lagon, collines, dunes et sommets enneigés
consigne_scene: A wide dreamlike panorama made entirely of torn-paper collage that blends several kinds of journeys side by side: a turquoise lagoon with a small island and two palm trees on the left, rolling green hills with a winding footpath in the middle, a golden dune, snowy peaks and a small hot-air balloon on the right, a few paper birds in a pale sky, the main elements kept in the central horizontal band

emplacement: Faire un don · ouverture plein cadre
alt: Montgolfière en papier fuchsia et abricot qui s'élève au-dessus de collines en papier
consigne_scene: A single hot-air balloon made of fuchsia pink and apricot orange paper strips rising gently above layered torn-paper hills at sunrise, a few small paper birds flying alongside, a generous calm cream sky around it

emplacement: Mon projet de voyage · image à côté du titre
alt: Carnet de voyage ouvert en papier, entouré d'un avion en papier, d'une boussole et d'un chapeau de paille
consigne_scene: Seen from directly above, an open travel journal made of cream paper lying on a kraft paper table, both pages completely blank except for one pressed dried flower, around it a folded paper airplane, a small compass with tick marks only and no numbers, a straw sun hat and torn scraps of coloured paper shaped like small islands

alt: Collage : une personne de dos médite au-dessus d'une mer de nuages au lever du soleil
consigne_scene: A single person seen strictly from behind, sitting cross-legged on a rocky ledge above a soft sea of clouds at sunrise, distant mountain tops emerging from the clouds, calm and meditative

alt: Collage : deux silhouettes de dos au bout d'un ponton au coucher du soleil, sous des lampions
consigne_scene: Two figures seen strictly from behind sitting close together at the end of a small wooden pier at sunset, warm paper lanterns strung above them, a small wrapped gift box with a ribbon beside them, a calm sea

emplacement: Carte du thème Expériences et saveurs
alt: Collage : étal d'épices colorées sous des tentures et des lanternes
consigne_scene: A colourful spice market stall with woven baskets full of spice mounds in ochre, red and saffron, hanging fabric awnings and small lanterns, nobody in the scene

emplacement: Carte du thème Villes, cultures et patrimoine
alt: Collage : toits d'une vieille ville aux tuiles ocre au soleil couchant
consigne_scene: Rooftops of an old generic town at golden hour, terracotta tiles, a few small domes and arches, a narrow street descending between the houses, laundry lines, no recognizable monument, nobody in the scene

emplacement: Carte du thème Façons de voyager (road trip, vanlife)
alt: Collage : route côtière sinueuse et petit van en papier
consigne_scene: A winding coastal road seen from above running through green hills towards a turquoise sea, a small plain cream camper van with no lettering driving along it, a few paper clouds

alt: Collage : une tortue de mer nage au-dessus d'un récif de corail
consigne_scene: A sea turtle gliding above a coral reef in clear turquoise water, a few small fish around, soft rays of sunlight from the surface

emplacement: Appel final de chaque page · fond de nuit
alt: Nuit en papier prune sur la mer, une lune de papier et un petit avion
consigne_scene: A calm night over the sea made of deep plum and dark midnight blue torn papers, a round cream paper moon in the upper right, tiny paper stars, a small folded paper airplane far away on the left, the central area stays dark, simple and uncluttered
